value.rationale: Natural closure classification for the non-box prism operation under facet-foot iteration. For every regular n-gonal base n≥5 and every h≠a it provides an exact primitive four-return, a sharp two-return resonance and a dimension-independent contraction invariant, while arbitrary bicentric higher-dimensional bases supply a broad structural class. This is a motivated return-dynamics gap, not a parameter-renaming of the known rectangular-box result.
